test: Saved Content persistence + restart recovery (docs/phase-2-7-1-audit.md section E/O)
method: A real on-disk SQLite file is used (tempfile::tempdir), not an in-memory connection kept open. The connection is dropped and reopened mid-test, exactly as a real application close/relaunch would.
verified: a ContentCandidate constructed and accepted exactly as commands::accept_content_candidate would produce it is persisted via persist_saved_content_candidate
after closing and reopening the same on-disk database file, the candidate is still present via list_saved_content_candidates_for_service
id, status (Accepted), titleOrLabel, confidence.score, and assertionLevel all survive restart unchanged - provenance is never re-derived, only re-read from the persisted JSON payload
limitations: Environment A only - real Windows filesystem/database-path close-reopen behavior (Environment C) not performed this phase. The in-memory content_candidate_queue view (list_accepted_content_candidates, still scoped to the active service) is unchanged and not itself durable - only the new saved_content_candidates table is.
